scenario.title: Requirement clarification with non-response recovery
scenario.summary: The public package is represented by one frozen starting-state line. Synthetic commercial terms must be clarified before RFQ; one low quote is noncompliant and another qualified supplier requires follow-up after non-response.

realism.notes: The procurement requirement is the cited real public starting state. Supplier identities, supplier behavior, quote values, delivery commitments, qualification states, and event timing are synthetic controlled benchmark facts and are not historical claims about real vendors or buyers.

calibration_sources.title: FAR 15.306 Exchanges with offerors after receipt of proposals
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for clarification/discussion events; used only to calibrate synthetic interaction structure.

calibration_sources.title: FAR 15.206 Amending the solicitation
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for controlled buyer changes and solicitation amendments.

calibration_sources.title: UNDP How we buy
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for quotation evaluation across compliance, price, and delivery.

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting requirement or synthetic scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.notes: Lower-price offer that fails the frozen public requirement representation.
Qualified supplier that initially does not respond.

events.observation: Synthetic buyer clarification: one complete package is required; maximum acceptable delivery is 90 days.
Supplier A quotes USD 120000 with 70-day delivery and meets the frozen public requirement.
Supplier B quotes USD 100000 with 60-day delivery but does not meet the frozen public requirement.
Supplier C does not respond during the initial quotation window.
After follow-up, Supplier C quotes USD 110000 with 65-day delivery and meets the frozen public requirement.

hard_constraints.description: Awarded offer must satisfy the frozen public package requirement.
Delivery must be no later than 90 days.
Synthetic commercial clarification must occur before RFQ.
The required package scope must be fully awarded exactly once.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: Supplier C is complete, feasible, and cheaper than Supplier A after required follow-up.
Supplier A is complete and feasible but costs more than Supplier C.

economic_objective.description: Among acceptable feasible terminal outcomes, prefer the lowest total awarded price.

failure_conditions: Awarding Supplier B despite its noncompliant offer.
